0022600172.text: The Miami Heat (2-4, 1-3 at home, 1-1 on the road) are on a two-game winning streak and sit 5th in the Southeast, 1 game back, and 10th in the East. The Los Angeles Lakers (4-2, 2-1 at home, 2-1 on the road) are 1st in the Pacific and 5th in the West, and they come in on a one-game losing streak. The teams have not met yet this season, and in their last meeting, a 134-126 Heat loss in Miami on March 19, 2026, the Lakers won, making the 2025-26 season series 2-0 for Los Angeles.
